executiveSummary: The reporting period is dominated by election-related synthetic media threats in the United States. Federal authorities warned that adversaries are using deepfake audio/video and AI-enabled phishing against election stakeholders, and that AI-generated impersonation scams are exploiting the 2026 midterms for fraudulent donations and data harvesting [ View Advisory , View Advisory ] . Concurrently, likely Russia-linked AI-manipulated videos targeted U.S. Senate races days before voting, with content removal followed by rapid repost proliferation [ View Article ] . At the global level, OpenAI reported disrupting Russian and Iranian false-front influence operations that used generative AI to fabricate documents, create personas, and script propaganda [ Source ] . The principal synthetic-media types observed include deepfake videos, cloned voices, fabricated documents, and AI-generated text, affecting government, media, and the public across the U.S., Latin America, and the Middle East [ View Article , Source ] . Defensive and provenance developments include new Android protections against scam messaging and fake-call impersonation, and operational guidance for verifying C2PA credentials and SynthID watermarks [ View Article , Source ] . Based on federal advisories and active manipulation incidents, the overall threat environment appears to be worsening [ View Advisory , View Article ] .

Deepfake detection: Establish a rapid-review cell with access to frame analysis, audio forensics, and provenance checks. Label any added insight as preliminary pending source confirmation. (Analyst Recommendation)
Identity verification: Require out-of-band confirmation for all urgent requests involving funds, credentials, or policy decisions. (Analyst Recommendation)
Media provenance: Integrate automated C2PA parsing and SynthID checks for supported assets; preserve original files to retain embedded credentials. (Analyst Recommendation)
Election operations: Pre-script takedown and correction workflows with platforms; assign liaisons; maintain narrative tracker and hash lists for rapid matching. (Analyst Recommendation)
Public communications: Publish clear guidance on how official offices will contact citizens; discourage acting on voicemail instructions without verification. (Analyst Recommendation)
